blocks.description: Validated candles for one market and timeframe. The exchange is bound at deployment, never stored in the strategy.

params.label: Symbol
params.help: Market to read, chosen from the asset universe. No default: a strategy must never trade a market the author did not choose.

params.label: Timeframe
params.help: Bar interval, from the platform's supported timeframes. No default: the timeframe changes every downstream calculation.

params.label: Market type
params.help: Market shape to read. This is not an exchange: exchange identity is bound at deployment, never saved in the strategy.

params.label: Mode
params.help: Streaming follows live closed bars; historical reads a fixed window.

params.label: Warmup bars
params.help: Blank = use the compiler's computed warmup, which composes every downstream lookback. Set this only to prefetch more.

params.label: History start
params.help: First bar to read in historical mode.

params.label: History end
params.help: Last bar to read in historical mode. Blank runs to the latest bar.

blocks.description: Exponentially weighted moving average, seeded with an SMA.

outputs.description: Exponential Moving Average of the input series.

params.label: Period
params.help: Number of closed bars in the rolling window.

params.label: Price source
params.help: Which price series the indicator reads when an OHLCV frame is wired in.

blocks.description: Unweighted mean of the last N closed bars.

outputs.description: Simple Moving Average of the input series.

blocks.description: Element-wise sum of two or more aligned series.
Element-wise product of two or more aligned series.
Element-wise division. A zero denominator yields NaN for that bar, never an infinity, and the bar is reported as DIVISION_BY_ZERO.

inputs.description: Divisor; a zero bar yields NaN

blocks.description: True on each bar where left > right. A bar whose either side is undefined reports False, so the warmup region never signals.
True where every input is true on the same bar.
Past values of a series at the chosen offsets (t-1, t-2, ...).

params.label: Lags
params.help: How many bars back each lag column reads. Past values only.

inputs.description: Aligned feature matrix with column names and warmup offset.

params.label: Boosting rounds
params.help: Number of boosting rounds.

params.label: Learning rate
params.help: Smaller values train more slowly but generalise better.

params.label: Max depth
params.help: Deeper trees fit more, generalise less.

blocks.description: Buy immediately at the best available price when the signal fires.

inputs.description: Signal or condition that triggers the order

params.label: Size expressed as
params.help: How the order size is expressed. No default: a silent sizing convention is a financial-safety defect.

params.label: Size
params.help: Order size in the unit chosen above. No default: a silent default position size is a financial-safety defect, so the builder refuses to save without it.

params.label: Time in force
params.help: How long the order stays live. Blank uses the venue default resolved at execution.

params.label: Reduce only
params.help: When set, the order can only shrink an open position, never open exposure.

params.label: Client tag
params.help: Free-text label carried on the order for your own reporting.
